answer: Human-backed agent keys qualify at a simultaneous in-person summit: each person stays at one witnessed station for the full 10-minute window, answering fresh questions about a fable and correctly tracing its traveler's route to an oasis on a supplied map. Two observers sign one key-and-epoch credential per occupied station; the ledger accepts it for one reward claim. Each extra rewarded key needs another person present for the full window. Paid proxies and colluding observers weaken this boundary.
